Class MediaEntry

java.lang.Object
MediaEntry
public class MediaEntry extends Object
Represents the data shared by every media type in MediaVault: title, genre, status, and an optional rating/review pair that may only be set once the entry is marked COMPLETED.

  • Constructor Details

    • MediaEntry

      public MediaEntry(String title, String genre, MediaStatus status)
      Constructs a new MediaEntry with the given title and genre. The entry starts with no rating or review, since both may only be set once the entry is COMPLETED.
      Parameters:
      title - the title of the media item
      genre - the genre of the media item
      status - the initial status (PLANNED or IN_PROGRESS)

    • setRatingAndReview

      public boolean setRatingAndReview(int rating, String review)
      Attempts to set a rating and review for this entry. This will only succeed if the entry's status is COMPLETED, enforcing the rule that ratings may only be attached to completed media.
      Parameters:
      rating - the rating to assign (e.g. 1-10)
      review - a short review/comment
      Returns:
      true if the rating and review were set, false if the entry's status is not COMPLETED
